_note: What you see: The workplace tokens of Esdoornveen on Cunningham: colours, status pills, the Today first card, shapes and codes in mono.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: De werkplek-tokens van Esdoornveen op Cunningham: kleuren, statuspillen, de kaart Vandaag eerst, vormen en codes in mono.
Voor docenten, BPV-begeleiders en de exa: For teachers, BPV supervisors and the exam board thematiq uses the Cunningham components with the tokens of Esdoornveen. Light and calm. Plum is an action, pink is your place in the menu or something new, red is urgency only.
Zachte vlakken met donkere tekst, altijd: Soft surfaces with dark text, always with a word next to it. The same seven for hours, assessments and exams.
Eén kaart per scherm mag roze zijn: wat: One card per screen may be pink: what needs attention now.
De website van Esdoornveen is hoekiger (: The Esdoornveen website is more angular (4 and 8). The workplace follows the Nextcloud scale, so built-in apps match. Shadow only on cards: 0 1px 2px, 4% ink.
Studentnummers, crebo's, werkprocessen e: Student numbers, crebos, work processes and exam codes in IBM Plex Mono 13.
Actief: roze tekst op roze licht: Active: pink text on pink light
